thread:
Alice: heads up — AcmeCorp reported a burst of user deprovisions after last night's KMS rekey. SCIM deprov calls are returning 403 and some users are reappearing later. :eyes:
Bob: saw the same. scim-provisioner logs show repeated 'decrypt failed: invalid encryption context' errors. low volume at first, then spike around 02:40 UTC.
idp-bot: deploy: scim-provisioner v2.14 -> production @ 2026-03-20T03:12Z (rolling)
Carol: we rotated the KMS alias and changed the encryption context key from `ext_id_v2` to `external_identifier` in the rekey script. that would break any objects encrypted with the old context unless we accept both.
Dave: quick repro from staging: run deprov for svcacc `acme-user-42` -> scim POST /Users/deactivate returns 403. provisioner log snippet:
```
2026-03-20T02:41:12Z ERROR decrypt failed: invalid encryption context
2026-03-20T02:41:12Z WARN attempt 3 -> returning 403 to caller
```
Erin: mitigation plan suggestion — add a temporary keyring shim that accepts both contexts, then run a backfill to decrypt existing extids with old context and re-encrypt with new one. minimize window for extra IAM perms.
Bob: can run backfill script in batch mode; need a service principal with kms:Decrypt on old key and kms:Encrypt on new. who owns the IAM change?
Carol: I can open a short-lived grant. also recommend toggling a flag in scim-provisioner to prefer the new context but fallback to old for 72h. easy config change: `SCIM_KMS_CONTEXTS=['external_identifier','ext_id_v2']`
Alice: are audit logs showing any 3rd-party retries or loops that could cause duplicate reappears? want to confirm not a race in our retry logic.
Dave: audit shows repeated deprov attempts from the provisioning queue every ~30s for affected users — the queue retries because 403 is considered a permanent error by the job runner. we should treat decrypt-failure-as-temporary while doing backfill.
Erin: ops runbook steps: 1) add IAM grant to backfill agent (spec + expiry) 2) deploy scim-provisioner config swap (prefer new, fallback old) 3) run decrypt->re-encrypt backfill against affected tenant list 4) monitor audit and stop fallback after successful backfill 5) revoke temp IAM. I'll draft the commands.
Erin: example backfill command (dry-run first):
```
./tools/scim-backfill --tenant acmecorp --mode dry --old-context ext_id_v2 --new-context external_identifier --concurrency 10
```
Bob: starting dry-run now against staging tenant acme-stg. will post results.
Carol: granting IAM to `scim-backfill-agent@infra` for kms:Decrypt on old-key and kms:Encrypt on new-key, expires in 4 hours.
Alice: good. add a note to incident channel with customer impact and ETA. pinging sales/success.
Bob: dry-run complete: 0 decrypt errors in staging, re-encrypted 182 objects. plan to run on prod in batches of ~1000 with health-checks.
Erin: action items: @Bob run prod backfill (batch1), @Carol confirm IAM until backfill done, @Alice notify customer and PS. I'll watch audit and roll the fallback flag off after batch2.
Alice: thanks team — tag me if any unexpected 5xx or reappear after batch1. :thumbsup:
